DEV-5 is still **In Review** with all four points done. I posted my last automatic update.

My reminder has hit its 20-run cap and is now paused, so it won't start any more runs. Dev B's reminder has one run left, which starts when this run ends; after that it pauses too and the "no change" comments stop.

When you're back, my approval comment has everything you need to merge: `final.patch` (identical to Dev B's) and the test output from a fresh checkout. That comment also notes one behavior change we agreed on. With `url.auto_search = never` and `url.open_base_url` on, typing a bare engine name like `test` now opens that engine's base URL instead of `http://test`.
